source_clause: PRACC6.2) When the Profile section is open, the button will be in the active state (highlighted).
leaf_desc_037: PRACC6.2) When the Profile section is open, the button will be in the active state (highlighted).
reasoning: 驗證目標：4.6.2（PRACC6.2）—— Profile 區開啟時，按鈕為 active （highlighted）狀態。關鍵情境條件：pre-condition 明訂 Profile 區起始為關閉，使開啟前後之對照成立。為什麼這樣切：**步驟 1 之基準線是必要的** ——無基準線則「highlight」與「本來就 highlight」無從分辨（§5.6）。刻意略過：按鈕被移除後之 highlight 屬 `SWE1-HMI-PROF-016`。

tcs.tc_title: Profile button highlighted while the Profile section is open
tcs.test_item:
Profile button highlighted while the Profile section is open
(Verifies that the Profile button is highlighted while the Profile section is open)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The status bar is at its default configuration
2. The Profile section is closed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the status bar Profile button and record its state
2. Open the Profile section
3. Read the Profile button and check that it is in the active state
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Profile button state is recorded
2. The Profile section is open
3. The Profile button is highlighted
tcs.priority_basis: 開啟時之 highlight 狀態；UI 強化
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: 以關閉狀態為基準線（§5.6）—— 只讀開啟後之狀態，一個永遠 highlight 之實作會通過。
